name: Quantum Katas
description: Quantum Katas is an open-source collection of self-paced tutorials and programming exercises for learning quantum computing using Microsoft's Q# language. The katas cover topics from basic quantum gates to advanced quantum algorithms and are designed to teach through hands-on problem-solving. Each kata includes automated verification of solutions.
